functions.description: Parse base syslog fields from smartd log line
Extract SMART attribute id, name, and before/after values from attribute change messages

functions.filter: message && message.startsWith('SMART overall-health self-assessment test result')

functions.description: Classify severity based on smartd message content

add.name: severity
add.value: message && message.match(/FAILED|error count increased|Currently unreadable|failed to read/) ? 'critical' : message && message.match(/changed from|previously logged error count/) ? 'warning' : message && message.match(/PASSED|OK|without error/) ? 'info' : 'notice'

add.name: action
add.value: message && message.match(/self-test completed without error/) ? 'self_test_pass' : message && message.match(/FAILED!?/) ? 'health_check_fail' : message && message.match(/PASSED/) ? 'health_check_pass' : message && message.match(/changed from/) ? 'attribute_change' : message && message.match(/error count/) ? 'error_count_change' : 'status_report'
